text.tspan: I am an Information Systems undergraduate student at Institut
Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) who bridges technical
adaptability with organizational leadership. I specialize in AI-
assisted Vibe Coding and modern web platforms, alongside a
strong passion for robotics, microcontrollers, and hardware
integration. Beyond technical execution, my background leading
student organizations drives my ability to coordinate cross-
functional teams and manage complex projects. I am always open
to exciting collaborations and internships where I can build
Right now I am actively leveling up my programming and web
development skills through my internship at Barunastra as part of
the Programming Division Web Development Subdivision. Beyond
my internship I enjoy building practical web systems exploring
hardware software integration and connecting digital platforms
with real world applications to solve structural challenges.
